gloss: to put on top; to cover; to place over

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {被|かぶ}せていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cover, to put over, to place on top
definitions.explanation: To place something over or on top of something else so as to cover it.

definitions.gloss: to put (a hat, etc.) on someone; to make someone wear
definitions.explanation: To place a hat, hood, or similar item on someone else's head.
To make someone else bear the responsibility or blame for something.

examples.english: Put a lid on the pot.
I put a blanket over the sleeping child.

examples.english: I finished the cake by coating it with chocolate.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: {被|かぶ}る (intransitive, to wear/to be covered)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ふた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|かぶ}せる: to put a lid on
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|かぶ}せる: to put a blanket over
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|かぶ}せる: to put a hat on (someone)
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|かぶ}せる: to shift blame onto
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|かぶ}せる: to frame someone

NUANCE: {被|かぶ}せる is the causative-like transitive form of {被|かぶ}る. While {被|かぶ}る means to wear or be covered oneself, {被|かぶ}せる means to put something over someone/something else.
